proves.claim: A plain next served by the resident board that waits past 60 s returns its own exit 4 idle line, not RESIDENT_COMMAND_CEILING.

cli.io-resident-board.waiting-next-outli.why: Without it, every idle plain next under the warm resident process would exit 1 with RESIDENT_COMMAND_CEILING instead of its idle answer.

proves.claim: Every command but a waiting next keeps the 60 s ceiling, which still ends a hung command at 60 s.

cli.io-resident-board.other-commands-kee.why: Without it, the waiting-next exemption could widen into a blanket ceiling raise and hung commands would hold the resident slot again.

proves.claim: A busy file naming its command ceiling keeps a waiting next busy past 60 s and frees the slot only past that ceiling and grace.

cli.io-resident-board.busy-file-carries-.why: Without it, another client would reap the resident process as wedged 70 s into a waiting next.
